subject: Discovery synthesis: SDK adaptations, streaming & rerank checklist

Subject: Discovery synthesis: SDK adaptations, streaming & rerank checklist

Thanks for the time today, Jared — great conversation. Below is a short synthesis of what we heard, the immediate goals you shared, and the pragmatic integration options Redwood recommends for OliveTech's use case. I captured action items and owners at the end. Call recording and a draft MAP are attached for reference.

Key pain points you reiterated
- Latency spikes when users trigger long multi-turn assistant sessions (primarily 8k+ context windows).
- Reranking quality is inconsistent for short answer scoping — you lose ordering fidelity on narrow, domain-specific docs.
- Need for deterministic structured outputs for our forms pipeline (JSON schema enforcement).
- Compliance constraint: PII must not leave your VPC for the pilot dataset; long-term you may move to Dedicated.

Goals we agreed on
- Pilot: 6-week technical POC focused on (1) streaming generation with partial results to UX, (2) an embeddings + rerank pipeline for document search, and (3) structured output validation using function-calls or a lightweight schema wrapper.
- Success metric: median end-to-end answer latency < 800ms for common flows; rerank top-1 precision uplift >= 10% vs current baseline.

Recommended integration approach (practical order)
1) Streaming sockets for user-facing flows (reduce perceived latency): prototype with Redwood streaming SDK hooks and a small prefix cache.
2) Rerank + embeddings: two-stage pipeline — fast embedding retrieval (client-side cache) then Redwood-hosted reranker for final ordering; consider quantized embed models to cut cost.
3) Structured outputs: prefer function-calling wrapper for deterministic fields; fallback: post-parse validation + rejection/repair loop.

Constraints & open questions
- On-prem pilot: what environment (K8s, bare-metal)? We need a short inventory to size Dedicated vs Private.
- Token budget assumptions for interactive sessions — impacts batching config and cost.
- SOC2 evidence request and retention policy for logs (Jared asked for 90d retention).

Agreed next steps
- Redwood: send MAP draft and an estimated cost workbook by EOD tomorrow (attached: est_costs_embed_rerank.xlsx). Owner: Ben.
- OliveTech: share pilot infra inventory (K8s cluster specs + network egress constraints). Owner: Jared. Due: Fri 2027-05-07.
- Joint kickoff: schedule 30–45m technical alignment with engineering + security next week. Proposed windows in the MAP.

Attachments: olivetech_map_draft.pdf (draft), call_recording_20270503.mp3 (recording), est_costs_embed_rerank.xlsx (cost estimate stub)

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the MAP and cost workbook shortly.

Quick technical notes from our side after reviewing the call: 
- Streaming: Redwood SDK supports chunked token streaming and partial-score callbacks. For your K8s egress constraints we can host a relay in your VPC (Private deployment) to avoid outbound calls. That path adds ~1–2 weeks to setup but meets your security ask.
- Rerank: for domain-specific ranking we usually recommend fine-tuning the final reranker (if you have labeled pairs). Alternative: parametric reranker + calibration layer to reduce top-1 drift.
- Structured outputs: function-calling will enforce schema at generation time; we can add a thin validation layer to auto-repair small schema issues before returning to the client.

I attached a short cost workbook with a couple scenarios — baseline, optimized-quantized, and dedicated-reserve. These are rough but will help scope the budget conversation.

Attachments: est_costs_embed_rerank.xlsx (see tab: pilot_scenarios)
